Background Texture Maker

Give your site a little grit

This page generates CSS for textured backgrounds. Play with the sliders to preview it here. Copy/paste the code into your stylesheet to apply it to your site. 






Details


    

  • 

    The texture comes from an SVG that's encoded
for use as a CSS background-image.
    

    • 

  • 

    The SVG and the CSS background-size are both
set to 150px x 150px. This prevents the texture
from changing at different page sizes.
    

    • 

  • 

    The Lightness, Chroma, and Hue sliders set the base background variables for an oklch
color.
    

    • 

  • 

    The Texture slider controls how strong
the textured effect is.
    

    • 

  • 

    The original version of this tool used base64 encoding.
Tyler Sticka reminded me
that that's not necessary for SVGs.
The output is escaped plain-text now
as a result.
    

    • 



Outro


The textured effect can go from barely
perceptible to in your face.
I'm leaning toward the subtler
site. That's not to dismiss the more
overt. I expect to change things
up from time to time. I hope you enjoy
experimenting with it too.


-a













    
P.S. At press time, I have a little
text-shadow on the page to
add some separation to the prose.
It's set to compliment a darker
palette. It's not dynamic. That
can make it look weird with different
background colors. Especially as they
get lighter.


The shadow isn't part of the CSS
payload from the tool. Playing
with it is left as an exercise
for the reader.
